crossRefs.note: They reasoned with one another, saying, “It’s because we have no bread.”
They kept this saying to themselves, questioning what the “rising from the dead” meant.
An argument arose among them about which of them was the greatest.
So Jesus said, “Do you also still not understand?
But Peter said, “Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten anything that is common or unclean.”

parallels.note: They forgot to take bread; and they didn’t have more than one loaf in the boat with them.
They reasoned with one another, saying, “It’s because we have no bread.”
Jesus, perceiving it, said to them, “Why do you reason that it’s because you have no bread? Don’t you perceive yet…

translations.web: They reasoned among themselves, saying, “We brought no bread.”
translations.bsb: They discussed this among themselves and concluded, “It is because we did not bring any bread.”
translations.kjv: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have taken no bread.
translations.asv: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, We took no bread.
